discrepancies.detail: Control lives inside ReauthorizeDialog ContentDialog (shown on URL expiry). Present in migrated Scenario6_RecoverableErrors.xaml. Absent from static UIA tree because the dialog is not shown at rest, identical to UWP. Not a defect.

Per-item button inside the pending-transfers ListView DataTemplate, wired Click=MakeCurrent_Click in migrated Scenario7_DownloadReordering.xaml. Not instantiated with an empty download collection, identical to UWP at rest. Not a defect.

noop on invoke because the sample server (http://localhost/BackgroundTransferSample) is not running and per-download controls need an active transfer. UWP behaves identically; UWP controls could not be actuated (CoreWindow UIA not enumerable), so no control is provably dead in WinUI vs UWP.

environment_limitations: UWP CoreWindow UIA not enumerable: title-driven nav + per-control actuation of the original app impossible; UWP golden is the single initial frame captured 7x.
WinUI 3 DirectComposition not captured by PrintWindow and no interactive desktop for screen capture; WinUI fidelity verified via UIA tree (real control bounds, text, default values).
